notes.note: Integration test review: inspected the remote OAuth MCP delivery claims against the combined engine resolver, proxy handler and runtime capability bypass. The only new test change composes the existing HTTP middleware with the real OAuth proxy; it protects scoped-token authentication, refusal of missing or paired-device credentials, and cookie exclusion upstream with or without a stray operator-session cookie. Existing account selection, refresh and adapter delivery assertions remain intact. The four requested suites passed 310 tests. A cookie-dependent mcp-token bypass mutation made the new assertion fail (expected 200, received 401); after byte-exact restoration all 38 engine OAuth tests passed. No product behavior or prose changes are needed, and no live provider/browser/native/hosted qualification is added.
